    Swapping pieces in code SOCKETS

    
      
    Sockets: head (holds head, hair and ears), chest, back, hips, shoulderL/R, wristL/R, handL/R (palm centre), footL/R, and with the second arms shoulder2L/R, wrist2L/R, hand2L/R. L is the character's left. setPiece(socket, object) replaces whatever that socket held, so outfits, props and new heads drop on without touching the body. Source: worldspace/characters/heads/body.js.
